description: Owner tags of the spare output slots a windowed custom ring transfer fills before its record output. Each spare slot is a zero-amount copy of the first output the sender owns, else of the last output, and publishes that output's owner tag: account index 0 when it is the change of a sender who pays the fee, else the inline view tag of the copied owner. Rust reads it from custom-rings/sdk/src/transfer.rs, TypeScript from sdk-libs/ts/test/ring-transfer.test.ts.
